frameworks.name: Claude Code
frameworks.summary_en: The reference dev-tool harness. A small AI core wrapped in a deep stack of deterministic plumbing — typed tool registry, permission gating, context compaction, transcript replay.
frameworks.summary_zh: 开发者工具方向的标杆 harness。小 AI 核心 + 厚重的确定性基础设施——类型化工具注册、权限门控、上下文压缩、对话回放。
frameworks.strengths_en: Permission Gate · Tool Dispatch · Context Compaction (engineering depth, not breadth)
frameworks.strengths_zh: 权限门 · 工具调度 · 上下文压缩（赢在深度而非广度）

frameworks.name: Codex CLI
frameworks.battlefield_zh: 开发者 agent · 多 surface
frameworks.summary_en: JSON-RPC over stdio gives one core, many surfaces (CLI, IDE, web). Rust gives the disposable per-request safety guarantees the agent loop needs.
frameworks.summary_zh: JSON-RPC over stdio 让一个内核接多种入口（CLI / IDE / Web）。选 Rust 是因为 agent 主循环天然需要
frameworks.strengths_zh: 沙箱 · 多 surface 协同 · MCP 集成

frameworks.name: Aider
frameworks.summary_en: Git is the source of truth. Every change lands as an atomic commit; the repository map is what the model sees. Minimalism by conviction.
frameworks.summary_zh: 把 Git 当真相来源。每次改动都是原子 commit；模型看到的是 repository map。极简是一种主张，不是缺陷。
frameworks.strengths_en: Git atomic commits · Repository Map · test-fix-retest self-heal
frameworks.strengths_zh: Git 原子提交 · 仓库地图 · 测试-修复-复测的自愈循环

frameworks.name: OpenCode
frameworks.battlefield_zh: 开发者 agent · 多客户端
frameworks.summary_en: Central server, many clients. A unified provider abstraction over 75+ LLMs, LSP integration for 30+ languages, four named agent personas, all in one monorepo.
frameworks.summary_zh: 中央 server + 多客户端的架构。75+ LLM 统一抽象、30+ 语言的 LSP 集成、四种命名 agent 角色，全部装在一个 monorepo 里。
frameworks.strengths_en: LSP integration · provider abstraction · agent personas
frameworks.strengths_zh: LSP 集成 · provider 抽象 · 多 agent 角色

frameworks.name: OpenClaw
frameworks.summary_en: A different posture from dev tools — a local Gateway that fans out across 20+ messaging channels, voice, and canvas. The interface is wherever the user already is.
frameworks.summary_zh: 跟前面那批开发者工具是完全不同的姿态——本地 Gateway 扇出到 20+ 消息渠道、语音、画布。入口就在用户原本就在的地方。
frameworks.strengths_en: Local Gateway · channel integrations · Voice + Canvas
frameworks.strengths_zh: 本地 Gateway · 多 channel 集成 · 语音 + 画布

frameworks.name: Hermes Agent
frameworks.battlefield_zh: 个人 AI · 自我进化
frameworks.summary_en: Self-improvement is the design center, not a feature bolted on. Three-tier memory (SQLite FTS5 + procedural skills + episodic), experience replay, and a skill package format that earns its complexity.
frameworks.summary_zh: 自我进化是设计中心，不是附加功能。三层记忆（SQLite FTS5 + 程序性技能 + 情景记忆）、经验回放、对得起这个复杂度的 skill package 格式。
frameworks.strengths_en: Three-tier memory · skill packages · experience replay (deepest agent stack here)
frameworks.strengths_zh: 三层记忆 · 技能包 · 经验回放（这八家里 agent 栈最深的一个）

frameworks.name: DeerFlow
frameworks.summary_en: Lead Agent + Sub-Agent topology as default. AIO Sandbox for execution, a modular skill system, persistent memory — built for coordination, not just code.
frameworks.summary_zh: 默认就是 Lead Agent + Sub-Agent 的拓扑。AIO Sandbox 跑执行环境、模块化 Skill System、持久化 memory——是为协作而不是只为写码设计的。
frameworks.strengths_en: Lead+Sub topology · AIO Sandbox · skill system · persistent memory
frameworks.strengths_zh: Lead+Sub 拓扑 · AIO Sandbox · 技能系统 · 持久化记忆

frameworks.name: OpenHands
frameworks.main_loop_zh: core/conversation.py (Conversation 类的 step 方法)
frameworks.summary_en: Stateless Agent + append-only EventLog: the agent has no internal state worth preserving — the log does. Replay, parallel agents, and optional isolation fall out of that one decision.
frameworks.summary_zh: Stateless Agent + 仅追加的 EventLog：agent 自己没有值得保留的内部状态——日志才有。重放、并行 agent、可选隔离，都是这一个决策的副产品。
frameworks.strengths_en: Stateless agent · EventLog replay · optional isolation · parallel multi-agent
frameworks.strengths_zh: 无状态 agent · EventLog 重放 · 可选隔离 · 并行多 agent

five_step.body_en: Every harness has a heart: an input → PRA → output loop. Grep for while/loop/step, follow the entry function. The main loop is your anchor — everything else is downstream.
five_step.body_zh: 每个 harness 都有一颗心脏：input → PRA → output 的主循环。grep while / loop / step，顺着入口函数追下去。找到主循环，其它东西都是它的下游。

five_step.body_en: Look at what the main loop calls — context handling (Perception), state management (Memory), LLM dispatch (Reasoning), tool calling (Action). Map each call to a cell on the 7 × 6 cognitive function × execution topology grid.
five_step.body_zh: 看主循环调了什么——context 处理（感知）、状态管理（记忆）、LLM 调用（推理）、工具调度（行动）。把每个调用映射到 7 × 6（认知功能 × 执行拓扑）矩阵里的一个格子。

five_step.body_en: About 70% of any framework is logger, config, type definitions, serialization. Skip it. Stay on the business spine: how the agent decides, how state flows, how tools get picked.
five_step.body_zh: 任何 framework 大约 70% 是 logger / config / 类型定义 / 序列化。跳过。盯住业务主干：agent 怎么决策、状态怎么传、工具怎么选。

five_step.title_en: 4 · Map — place onto the dual-axis matrix
five_step.body_en: Each surviving component takes a cell on the 7 × 6 matrix. The cells the framework fills become its coverage heatmap — the print-ready artifact for the framework.
five_step.body_zh: 把活下来的每个组件填到 7 × 6 矩阵的一个格子里。被填满的格子拼成这个框架的覆盖热力图——一张可以打印的工程档案。

five_step.title_en: 5 · Verify — pin every claim to source
five_step.body_en: Every judgment must be backed by file path + line number + function name. If you cannot link the claim to source, it isn't engineering knowledge yet — it's still impression.
five_step.body_zh: 每一个判断都要有文件路径 + 行号 + 函数名做支撑。如果你说不出源码出处，那还不是工程知识——只是印象。

common_ancestors.name: Unix Philosophy
common_ancestors.summary_en: Small tools, standard I/O. Lives in tool registries and JSON-RPC over stdio.
common_ancestors.summary_zh: 小工具 + 标准 I/O。活在工具注册表和 stdio 上的 JSON-RPC 里。

common_ancestors.name: Plan 9
common_ancestors.summary_en: Everything is a file. Lives in unified typed tool interfaces and provider abstractions.
common_ancestors.summary_zh: 一切皆文件。活在统一的类型化工具接口和 provider 抽象里。

common_ancestors.name: Erlang / OTP
common_ancestors.summary_en: Let it crash + supervisor tree. Lives in stateless agents and self-healing loops.
common_ancestors.summary_zh: let it crash + supervisor tree。活在无状态 agent 和自愈循环里。

common_ancestors.name: Kubernetes
common_ancestors.summary_en: Declarative spec + reconciliation. Lives in the agent main loop, the probabilistic version.
common_ancestors.summary_zh: 声明式 spec + 收敛循环。活在 agent 主循环里——概率版本的同一件事。

common_ancestors.name: Smalltalk
common_ancestors.summary_en: Objects send each other messages. Lives in A2A handoffs and inter-agent event logs.
common_ancestors.summary_zh: 对象之间发消息。活在 A2A handoff 和 agent 间的事件日志里。
